text:
alex: Quick ping — CI is red on windows-opt on the latest MSVC image. I see linker failures across a few services.
ci-bot: buildkite: job 4821 failed on windows-worker-3
ci-bot: Step 'bazel build //services/...:all --config=opt --cpu=x64_windows' exited with code 1
samir: Logs show unresolved externals in std::filesystem and std::pmr symbols. Here's a snippet:
```
LINK : fatal error LNK2019: unresolved external symbol "public: class std::filesystem::path __cdecl std::filesystem::path::operator/(class std::filesystem::path const &)" (?operator@path@filesystem@std@@QEBAAEAV12@AEBV1@Z) referenced in function "void __cdecl foo()" (?foo@@YAXXZ)
```
priya: That looks like mismatched C++ standard lib or /std:c++20 vs older CRT. Did someone roll the MSVC runtime image or change CRT flags?
alex: I reproduced locally with the pinned toolchain from the image and it links fine. The failing jobs use `//bazelrc:windows-image-latest` which now points to `microsoft/windows-msvc:2022-14.3.0` — suspect the image changed default CRT (/MD vs /MT).
kevin: Any recent changes to compile_flags_windows? I recall a change around PR 1750 toggling /MD.
samir: Good call — PR #1750 modified the CRT selection but the platform conditionals were slippery. Could be the macro expanding on windows CI only. We should bisect.
priya: Can someone kick off a bisect or rerun with the previous image digest to confirm image vs build flag?
alex: Started a bisect job comparing master vs master~10 with the windows image pinned to the older digest: https://buildkite.com/r/redwood/ci/builds/5823
ci-bot: Rerun requested: build 5824 (windows-legacy-image) started.
samir: While that runs, a short workaround is to add explicit linkopts to the failing targets to neutralize the CRT mismatch, but that's a bandaid.
kevin: If it's image-level, we should pin the image in bazelrc for now and roll a proper fix. Priya, can you draft a PR to pin the previous digest + add a changelog note?
priya: On it — will open a PR in ~10m and add an eng-infra tag. I'll also mark the affected targets flaky so the rollout doesn't block.
alex: Update from bisect: job 5823 indicates first bad commit is 8f1c2d — the compile-flag refactor that toggled /MD for windows. That points to our change, not the image.
kevin: Ok — plan: revert the refactor (temporary) and create a targeted patch that sets CRT based on an explicit bazel config. Priya, please include the revert in the PR.
samir: Revert PR #1768 created, testing now.
ci-bot: build 5830 (revert-1768) started on windows-worker-5.
ci-bot: build 5830 finished — SUCCESS.
alex: Triage complete — revert fixes CI. We'll schedule a follow-up to implement an explicit, documented CRT switch and add a CI job to catch this scenario.
kevin: Thanks all. Leaving thread open until revert merges and master is green. :thumbsup:
priya: Revert PR merged and master green on windows. Adding a postmortem note to eng-infra/ops board.
alex: Closing loop — resolved. Thanks everyone for the quick triage.
